steps.description:
IDE stands for Integrated Development Environment. It is a software application for programmers write, test, and debug code. The black section on the left is an IDE for you to enter and run Python codes.

  1. Type in the code below and press the play button to run:    

    print("Hello, world")

  2. Click on the Console tab to see the output. Notice that the print command displays a text on the console.
            

  3. in this lesson, we'll try out another online IDE. Open a new internet browser tab and go to the link programiz.com.
  4. Scroll down until you see Python Compiler and click on it.

                    

  5. Refer to the image below on how you can work on this IDE.



Print your name using the Programiz IDE.

Show the instructor your code when it is done. You do not need to submit.
